question: Who among the following physicists wrote an autobiography ‘Autobiographical Notes’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Albert Einstein**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Albert Einstein wrote his autobiography titled **'Autobiographical Notes'** in 1949.
 
• The book provides insights into Einstein’s personal thoughts and reflections on his life and scientific work.
 
• It was published as part of the volume "Albert Einstein: Philosopher-Scientist" edited by Paul Arthur Schilpp.
 
• Einstein's writings offer a unique perspective on his theories, experiences, and the scientific community of his time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Michael Faraday**

 
 
• Faraday is known for his contributions to the fields of electromagnetism and electrochemistry.
 
• He discovered electromagnetic induction, diamagnetism, and electrolysis.
 
 
 
• **Isaac Newton**
 
 
• Newton is renowned for his laws of motion and universal gravitation.
 
• His work "Philosophiæ Naturalis Principia Mathematica" laid the foundation for classical mechanics.
 
 
 
• **James Clerk Maxwell**
 
 
• Maxwell formulated the classical theory of electromagnetic radiation.
 
• His set of equations, known as Maxwell's equations, describe how electric and magnetic fields are generated and altered by each other and by charges and currents.
